corrections.prompt: Use case: text-localization. This is a precise one-label correction to an existing Chinese desktop UI mockup, not a redesign. Target image 1 C1 is 1485 x 1059; preserve exact size, aspect ratio, composition and all other content. Today 2026-10-21; preserve all existing historical dates unchanged. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Image 2 is SUPPORTING REFERENCE ONLY: it contains a correctly written top-tab label 对话完善; use only that wording and lettering as a reference, do not use image 2's layout. In Image 1, the active top fourth tab has an incorrect label 对边完善. Change that label to EXACTLY 对话完善. The four exact characters, with NO spaces: 对(U+5BF9), 话(U+8BDD, 言字旁讠 plus 舌), 完(U+5B8C), 善(U+5584). The second character is 话, never 边. Match original dark navy font, size, boldness, center positioning, and the chat-bubble icon to its left. Keep green active underline unchanged. Do not alter any body/document/chat text, other tabs, spacing, heading, dates, buttons, controls, or anything outside this one tab label. No additional text or watermark.

Precise screenshot text edit. Output exactly one full desktop screenshot matching IMAGE 1 at 1487x1058. IMAGE 1 is the ORIGINAL C1 edit target; IMAGE 2 is only a reference for the correct four-character Chinese wording in its fourth top tab. Copy the exact label '对话完善' from IMAGE 2's fourth top tab into IMAGE 1's fourth top tab, replacing IMAGE 1's old label '侧边对话'. Correct text is 对话完善. 话 uses the 讠 radical, not 辶; do not write 对边完善. Change ONLY that top tab text in IMAGE 1. Keep its chat icon, active green underline, card layout, document heading, conversation, Chinese patent text, save button, typography, historical dates, spacing, and all other content from IMAGE 1 unchanged. Date anchor is 2026-10-21, but do not update historical dates from IMAGE 1. Use the same clear Chinese UI font as the source and ensure the second character is the same 话 character already correctly written in IMAGE 2's tab label. This is only a label substitution, not a new design.
